title: FBI Photo B10
doc_notes: This document is an FBI submission to AARO containing a single infrared-style photograph with redactions and an incorrect system timestamp.

incidents.summary: A grainy infrared-style photograph shows a small, dark, circular object near the center of a crosshair reticle against a mountain background.
incidents.explanation: The operator was unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: A small, dark, circular object is visible just to the top right quadrant of the center of the reticle.
